description: Updates a Project Inspection Template Item for a specified Project.

origin_id.description: ID of corresponding Project Inspection Template Item

section_id.description: ID of the section this item belongs to.

company_template_item_details.description: Item details inherited from the company template item.

optional.description: Whether the item may be left unanswered during an inspection.

hidden_at_project_template.description: Whether the item is hidden on the project template.

company_template_item_reference_ids.description: IDs of item references inherited from the company template item.

item_reference_ids.description: IDs of item references defined on this project template item.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Item Response Set.

name.description: The name of the Item Response Set

active.description: Indicates whether an Item Response Set is available for use.

created_at.description: Represents when an Item Response Set was created

updated_at.description: Represents when a Item Response Set was last updated

responses.description: Responses that belong to this Response Set.

deletable.description: Indicates whether a Response Set is deletable.

procore_standard.description: Indicates whether a Response Set is a Procore standard set.
